meaning: Honest scope for #182: the expressivist reply survives Geach's equivocation charge. A concrete model satisfies constant-meaning expressivism (a moral sentence means the same in every occurrence; Blackburn §4.1.1, Gibbard §2.5) together with all the shared data that refute naive emotivism, so no refutation of expressivism follows from them. What it does not show: that expressivism explains why the argument is valid. That needs a logic of attitudes, which the corpus does not yet model; the costs of Blackburn's attitude-clash explanation are recorded as open attacks (STMT-PRAGMATIC-INCOHERENCE-IS-NOT-INCONSISTENCY; Schroeder's STMT-EXPRESSIVISM-NEEDS-B-TYPE-INCONSISTENCY, scoped to attitude-type architectures, which leaves A-type replies open), and their formalization is the candidate EXPRESSIVIST-LOGIC-OF-ATTITUDES-COST. No refutes relation targets expressivism.
